subject: BayCity Tech Roadshow — crew rotation, travel & last-minute swap

Can you confirm the list of crew arriving on Thursday vs early Friday?

Also — the venue has limited secure storage; if you have a kit that needs overnight storage, let me know so we can reserve space.

Thanks,

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up.

Quick summary from our side: we plan a 4-person crew. Proposed split: 2 on-site arriving Thursday afternoon (load-in) and 2 arriving early Friday AM for the early-access window. That gives us coverage for late-night setup + first-day demos. See attached "proposed-roster.xlsx" for names, home airports, and preferred travel windows.

Questions:
- Is there a secure overnight storage lock for a single "kit" (we have a demo laptop, banner, and two small backdrops)? If so, can you reserve a 4x4 unit with a contact person?
- Any constraints on badge printing time? We'll need access to print or pick up badges by 06:00 Friday.

Marcus / Marissa — can you confirm travelers and any dietary restrictions for crew meals? I can book hotels after you confirm.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

- Tyler Shaw (Lead) — EWR red-eye arrival Thu 14:50 (will take shared shuttle)
- Priya N. — SFO direct Thu 16:10
- Hana L. — SFO -> DEN red-eye (arrives Fri 05:40)
